reasons.FUJISAWA_REAL_2D_ARTIFACT_CONNECTED_IN_V: The hash-bound Fujisawa-Enoshima VGI CANDIDATE artifact is available through explicit viewer opt-in.

reasons.REAL_GEOMETRY_ARTIFACTS_AVAILABLE: The available scope is all-three-city source-traceable VGI CANDIDATE geometry only.

reasons.M7_CONNECTED_TO_REAL_EDGES: M7 core exists, but zero candidate edges have the required reviewed inputs and zero are computed.

three_dimensional_fallback: A 3D load, tile, render, or timeout failure returns to the current 2D layer and preserves its URL state.
